# dataversecontact_scopes (Data Source)

Lists all configured scopes in the Dataverse Contact API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dataversecontact_scopes" "all" {}

output "scopes" {
  value = data.dataversecontact_scopes.all.scopes
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier.
- `scopes` (List of String) List of scope names.
